title: Aeromagnetic map of parts of the Brunswick and Savannah 1[degree] X 2[degree] quadrangles, Georgia and South Carolina
citation: U.S. Geological Survey, 1976, Aeromagnetic map of parts of the Brunswick and Savannah 1 X 2 quadrangles, Georgia and South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-76-155, map scale 1:250,000.
notes: Aeromagnetic contour map (single OCR sheet). It shows total-intensity magnetic contours (interval 10.0 gammas, datum 52,563.82 gammas, flight altitude 500 feet AGL, 1.0 mile line spacing, flown 1974-1975) and no geologic map units, borings, structures, groundwater data or reference list, so no values fit the extraction schema. Contour values on the map face are not legible in the OCR text.
